title: Existence of a cochain realization
statement: For a scheme X, module sheaves F,G and a computing resolution pairing D [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data], there exists a cochain morphism t from the tensor of the extended input complexes to the extended target satisfying D.Realizes t [def-sc-module-cup-realization-complex-data].

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, section-cup-product: construction before Lemma 20.31.3 and its global specialization

proof.text: Apply the component-data assembly theorem to obtain degree maps, their section formula, and the chain equation. Package the degree maps with HomologicalComplex.Hom.mk; the section formula is exactly D.Realizes.
